question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing cheerleader, Bob is playing right winger, and Claire is playing right back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Alice and Bob trade positions. Finally, Claire and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) cheerleader
(B) right winger
(C) right back
solution:
Player order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: cheerleader, right winger, right back
1. Alice ↔ Claire: right back, right winger, cheerleader
2. Alice ↔ Bob: right winger, right back, cheerleader
3. Claire ↔ Alice: cheerleader, right back, right winger
Bob plays right back, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
